svg.text: Rear 4-link, de Dion beam, frame-mounted LDU, 6 + 8 module pack (to scale, estimates)
Side view, driver side. Front of truck to the left. s = inches behind front axle, z = inches above ground.
dash-dot black: wheel center to CG height (26 in, assumed) over front axle. IC on this line = 100%
Top view. Front of truck to the left. Driver side at top.
blue: Panhard bar, level at ride height, ~12-14 in high
dashed orange: rear sway bar to the beam
upper + lower links, outboard of rails →
gray: de Dion tube, routed ahead of the LDU
Bracket settings (lower frame hole / upper frame hole)
Estimates from rear-axle.md geometry: wheel center 17.75 in,
CG ~26 in assumed (6 + 8 layout), 143.6 in wheelbase. Recheck with real weights,
ride height and tires. Suspension Engineering hole positions unknown.
